title: Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge
description:
Издание Digital Deluxe Edition

Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge: Championship EditionChampionship Edition is a discounted bundle that includes the base game of Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge + The Luxury Golf Cart + OST

Об игреBrendan Keogh’s Putting Challenge is a relaxing open-world golf game about all the parts other golf videogames cut out. Sounds tedious? It sort of is. 

With up to four players on a single device (or online by using Remote Play), you have complete freedom to explore the massive open-world at your own pace with your friends. Play a round of mini-golf, compete on a full 9 hole course, go for a bike ride or just see who can hit the ball the furthest at the driving range. It’s entirely up to you.

Originally developed in Pico-8, this labour of love has been painstakingly rebuilt and expanded on to include a larger world and more features, while retaining the original 8-bit retro charm.

Features:• Massive open-world to explore

• Five 9-hole courses including; mini-golf, an extra-large desert course, and secret holes hidden throughout the world

• Up to four players local (or online by using Remote Play)

• Full controller support

• Two players are able to play using a single keyboard

• Save your progress for later

• Original soundtrack by Dan Golding (Untitled Goose Game, Frog Detective)

• 22 Achievements
Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge: Luxury Golf CartWalking to each hole feeling a bit tedious? Good, it's meant to. But! Why not travel in style with your very own 4-seater luxury golf cart! 
Ride around with 3 of your other friends, or not. It's your cart so do what you want with it. (except drive it outside of the golf courses, which is strictly prohibited)
description_short: Brendan Keogh’s Putting Challenge is a local co-op golf game about all the parts other golf videogames cut out. Sounds tedious? It sort of is. Bring your friends! ⛳️
